parole.significato: arsenic (a toxic grey brittle nonmetallic chemical element (symbol As) with an atomic number of 33)
parole.testo: From a European language, from Classical Syriac ܙܪܢܝܟܐ (zarnīḵā), from Middle Persian *zarnīk, from Old Median *zaraniyakā, ultimately from Proto-Indo-European *ǵʰelh₃-.
